items.title: Vietnamese authorities prosecute shop owners over counterfeit Gucci, Hermes goods
items.summary: Vietnamese police prosecuted multiple well-known shop owners in Phu Tho and Can Tho provinces for selling more than 1,000 counterfeit branded items, including nearly 470 fashion pieces bearing the Gucci name found across three locations, plus fake goods sold as Louis Vuitton, Dior, Hermes, Nike and Adidas. Investigators also uncovered a Ho Chi Minh City manufacturing workshop and distribution through physical stores, Facebook, TikTok, Shopee and Zalo, with total seized-goods value in the billions of dong.

items.title: Gucci's Horsebit Ristretto bag gains Filipino celebrity following
items.summary: Philippine lifestyle outlet mega-asia profiled the Gucci Ristretto bag - beige GG canvas bordered in brown leather with the horsebit emblem, rooted in the house's 1950s equestrian heritage - noting it has been carried by Marian Rivera, Pia Wurtzbach-Jauncey, Kylie Verzosa, Michelle Dee, Bella Racelis and other Filipino celebrities. The piece frames the bag's understated ease as key to its growing local following, part of Demna-era product coverage.

items.title: Kering H1 2026 results: Gucci organic sales fall 2% in Q2, Asia-Pacific down 1%
items.summary: Kering's first-half 2026 results showed group revenue up 1% comparable to EUR 7.2 billion, marking a return to growth after 12 quarters of decline. Asia-Pacific (which includes SEA markets) was down 1% in Q2, improving gradually; Gucci's organic revenue fell 2% in Q2 (versus an 8% Q1 decline) as leather goods returned to growth on the Borsetto and Paparazzo bag launches, beating analyst expectations of a steeper drop. Jewelry outperformed, up 18% in Q2.

items.title: Thai fan account amplifies Gulf Kanawut's Gucci brand-ambassador status
items.summary: A Thai fan account (GulfSasha) posted about Gulf Kanawut Traipipattanapong being Gucci's first male Thai brand ambassador, tagging #GucciPreFall25 and the official @gucci account. Representative of sustained organic fan-driven amplification of Gucci's Thai ambassador roster on X, distinct from official brand posts.

items.title: Pantip thread asks pricing for Gucci bee-motif wallet
items.summary: A Thai community thread on Pantip (Thailand's largest general forum) asks fellow users for current pricing on a short Gucci bee-pattern wallet, reflecting ongoing grassroots price-comparison discussion among Thai consumers about Gucci small leather goods versus international pricing. Undated thread surfaced in active forum search; included as representative of persistent Thai community price-sensitivity chatter around Gucci, though exact post date could not be verified.

items.title: Luxury brands including Gucci lean into Southeast Asia growth story
items.summary: Retail Brew examined why luxury houses, Gucci among them, are expanding across Southeast Asia to capture younger consumers, rising wealth and tourism, citing Bangkok's Siam Paragon and Central Embassy, Marina Bay Sands' USD 8 billion repositioning in Singapore, and continued mono-brand boutique expansion in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi as evidence the region remains a bright spot even as Gucci's global sales have struggled.

items.title: Analysis: why Southeast Asian shoppers keep splurging on luxury despite global slowdown
items.summary: An academic luxury-sector analysis notes that while global luxury sales including Gucci's have declined, Southeast Asian consumers continue splurging, with Indonesia's luxury market near USD 3.1 billion and Thailand's near USD 3.3 billion; separately cites survey data showing Malaysia/Singapore consumers (63%) are among the most self-conscious globally about displaying branded luxury items, a nuance relevant to how quiet-luxury positioning may land regionally. Exact publish date not shown on page; content reflects 2026 market figures.
